The '''Rusty Reach''' was a scrap reclamation plant located to the north of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], deep within the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==Description==
Located forty kilometers north-northeast of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], Rusty Reach was a walled compound within the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]].The surrounding terrain had been cleared and excavated to serve as a killing ground for the complex. Rusting metal towers patrolled by armed guards looked out over the killing field as a security measure to keep intruders away. The interior of the complex was filled with piles of sorted scrap, which was tended to by fifty slaves. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] named [[Gerk]] was the supervisor of the facility. Gerk had overseen a raid on [[Redlake]] village where the slaves were acquired. [[Illo Vandin]] wished to have a package of [[tyrru]] delivered to the camp.<ref name="MPQ" />
